items.title: Stronger primary, preventive care for Pinoys sought
items.description: Sen. Bong Go has urged the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. to further strengthen primary and preventive health care while ensuring adequate benefits for Filipinos undergoing dialysis and other life-sustaining treatments following PhilHealth’s disclosure that around 25 percent of its payouts goes to dialysis.

items.title: DepEd to include mathematics  in ARAL program expansion
items.description: The Department of Education (DepEd) will expand its Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning  Program to include Mathematics in an effort to sustain gains in the Program for International Student Assessment 2025.“The latest PISA results showed us that real progress is possible when we focus on foundational skills, but it also served as a clear reminder of how much ground we still need to cover,” Education Secretary Sonny Angara said.

items.title: Coast Guard activates Kalayaan auxiliary district
items.description: The Philippine Coast Guard  activated an auxiliary district yesterday in the Kalayaan Island Group to enable faster response, better sustainment of operations and closer coordination with the municipality of Kalayaan.

items.title: Marcos to agencies: Prioritize food, fuel, electricity
items.description: President Marcos is zeroing in on efforts to ensure enough food, fuel and electricity supply after inflation soared to 7.2 percent last month due to the Middle East conflict and recent disasters, Malacañang said.

items.title: 80% of Pinoy children face violence – CEAP
items.description: Eighty percent of Filipino children have experienced some form of violence at home, school, workplace, community or in dating relationships, the Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines (CEAP) revealed as it called for stronger child protection measures in Catholic schools through a protocol.

items.title: Palace seeks probe on Gracioso’s claims
items.description: Malacañang has called for a deeper probe into the claims of dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. that he delivered more than P2 billion in cash to Vice President Sara Duterte and members of her family on the instructions of former House speaker Lord Allan Velasco.

items.title: COA upholds disallowance of P73.29 million OVP secret funds
items.description: The Commission on Audit has affirmed with finality the disallowance against the Office of the Vice President (OVP)’s P73.29 million in confidential funds that were spent in just 11 days in December 2022.

items.title: DOH monitoring Russia outbreak
items.description: The Department of Health is closely monitoring developments in Russia involving the death of a laboratory technician at a plague research institute, as well as recommendations from the World Health Organization.

items.title: House OKs P7.2 trillion 2027 budget bill
items.description: The House of Representatives has approved on second reading the government’s proposed P7.2-trillion spending plan for fiscal year 2027.

items.title: DA: Rice imports may breach 5 million MT
items.description: The country is expected to import more than five million metric tons of rice this year to strengthen supply as domestic production is projected to decline due to the effects of El Niño, according to the Department of Agriculture.

items.title: Nobel chemistry prize goes to pair who solved mystery of ‘mirror image’ molecules
items.description: This year's prize was awarded for discoveries that showed how chemical reactions can be driven to favor a single molecular mirror image, work that has been key for chemists who design reactions for the manufacture of pharmaceuticals
